d: Addressing the INDIA bloc rally in Delhi, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav alleged that several people who voted in the 2019 elections were unable to vote in the 2022 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections after their names were deleted from electoral rolls. He said the Samajwadi Party had submitted an affidavit to the Election Commission, but no action was taken on its complaint. Yadav added that public pressure was now forcing some action.
